name: Super Sonico Plus Size Adventure
source:
You are a cameraman and your new mission is to save the company from bankruptcy. A new trend has emerged in the city, it is not known what is causing it but if you don't hurry you will lose your job or even your life OMG. Your task is to interact with your models and make them want to gain weight and thus take the photos that will help the company.
